title: SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.33015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to maintain personalized and temporally coherent interactions, but repeated LLM inference for memory admission, extraction, and organization introduces substantial cost and latency. We present SLICE-Mem, a lightweight memory framework that combines salience-guided admission and predicate-centered information extraction. A compact classifier identifies user turns worth retaining, and a semantic-dependency-based extractor converts admitted turns into concise memory entries. This online pipeline requires no generative LLM calls, while cross-entry reconciliation is deferred to an offline consolidation stage. We evaluate SLICE-Mem on the weekly subset of Memora and LongMemEval-S using 8B and 30B Qwen backbones for memory construction and consolidation on both benchmarks. translated_title: SLICE-Mem：基于显著性门控的轻量级信息筛选，实现高效的LLM智能体记忆
translated_abstract: 长期记忆使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够保持个性化且时间连贯的交互，但为记忆的准入、提取和组织而反复调用LLM推理会带来巨大的成本和延迟。我们提出了SLICE-Mem，一个轻量级记忆框架，它结合了显著性引导的准入机制和以谓词为中心的信息提取。一个紧凑的分类器用于识别值得保留的用户对话轮次，一个基于语义依存的提取器则将准入的轮次转换为简洁的记忆条目。该在线流程无需任何生成式LLM调用，而跨条目的一致性协调则被推迟到离线整合阶段进行。我们在Memora的周度子集和LongMemEval-S上，分别使用8B和30B的Qwen骨干模型进行记忆构建与整合评估。在Qwen3-30B配置下，与生成式记忆基线MemOS相比，SLICE-Mem的在线流程……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SLICE-Mem通过显著性分类器进行记忆准入、基于语义依存的提取器生成简洁记忆条目，实现无需生成式LLM调用的轻量级智能体记忆管理，大幅降低成本和延迟。
en_tdlr: SLICE-Mem enables lightweight LLM agent memory curation by combining a salience classifier for memory admission with a semantic-dependency-based extractor, eliminating generative LLM calls in the online pipeline to substantially reduce cost and latency.
